## 🎯 Main Idea
- Master Nmap as the core tool for network enumeration: host discovery, port/service scanning, and OS detection.
- Learn to tune scans for accuracy and performance, save results, extend with NSE scripts, and evade firewalls/IDS/IPS.

## 💥 Attack / Exploit Vectors
### Host Discovery
- Determine which hosts are alive before port scanning.
- **Commands**
  - `-sn` — Disables port scanning (ping/host discovery only)
  - `-PE` — Ping scan using ICMP Echo Requests
  - `-Pn` — Disables ICMP Echo Requests (treat hosts as up)
  - `-n` — Disables DNS resolution
  - `--disable-arp-ping` — Disables ARP ping requests
  - `--packet-trace` — Show all packets sent and received
  - `--reason` — Display the reason for a result

### Host & Port Scanning
- Identify open ports and scan technique (SYN/ACK/UDP).
- **Commands**
  - `10.10.10.0/24` — Target a network range
  - `-p-` — Scan all ports
  - `-p22-110` — Scan a port range
  - `-p22,25` — Scan specific ports
  - `-F` — Scan top 100 ports
  - `--top-ports=<num>` — Scan the N most frequent ports
  - `-sS` — TCP SYN (stealth) scan
  - `-sA` — TCP ACK scan
  - `-sU` — UDP scan

### Service & OS Enumeration
- Fingerprint service versions and target operating system.
- **Commands**
  - `-sV` — Scan discovered services for versions
  - `-O` — OS detection
  - `-A` — OS detection, service detection, and traceroute

### Nmap Scripting Engine (NSE)
- Run categorized scripts for deeper enumeration and vuln checks.
- **Commands**
  - `-sC` — Script scan with "default" category scripts
  - `--script <script>` — Run specified NSE script(s)

### Saving the Results
- Persist output for reporting and later parsing.
- **Commands**
  - `-oA filename` — Save in all formats
  - `-oN filename` — Save in normal format
  - `-oG filename` — Save in grepable format
  - `-oX filename` — Save in XML format

### Performance Tuning
- Speed up or slow down scans and control timing/retries.
- **Commands**
  - `--max-retries <num>` — Retries for specific ports
  - `--stats-every=5s` — Show scan status every 5s
  - `-v`/`-vv` — Verbose output
  - `--initial-rtt-timeout 50ms` — Initial RTT timeout
  - `--max-rtt-timeout 100ms` — Maximum RTT timeout
  - `--min-rate 300` — Packets sent simultaneously
  - `-T <0-5>` — Timing template (0 paranoid … 5 insane)

### Firewall & IDS/IPS Evasion
- Bypass filtering and detection using decoys, spoofing, and crafted source params.
- **Commands**
  - `-D RND:5` — Use random decoys to mask the real source
  - `-S 10.10.10.200` — Spoof the source IP address
  - `-e <iface>` — Specify the network interface
  - `-g <port>` — Specify the source port
  - `--dns-server <ns>` — Resolve via a specified name server

## 🛠️ Key Tools & Concepts
- Nmap — the primary network mapper/scanner driving the whole module.
- Enumeration — iterative information gathering as the foundation of a pentest.
- TCP 3-way handshake — underpins SYN vs. ACK scan behavior and firewall responses.
- Decoys & spoofing — hide the scanner's real identity from defenders.
- Timing templates — balance of stealth vs. speed.

## 🛡️ Mitigations
- Deploy firewalls, IDS/IPS to detect and block scanning activity.
- Rate-limit/drop unsolicited probes and filter ICMP to frustrate host discovery.
- Monitor for decoy/spoofed-source and timing anomalies indicative of evasion.
